data.notes: June 2027 confirmations are still sparse this far out, with the strongest verified listings currently coming from Naô Pool Club rather than the later-summer Starlite programme.

events.title: KISSTORY Marbella
events.summary: KISSTORY lists an exclusive Summer 2027 Marbella residency at Naô Pool Club running from 28 March until 26 September, with old-skool anthems, resident DJs and special guests. The ticketing page confirms the venue and residency run, which covers June 2027.

events.title: RICO
events.summary: RICO is a confirmed Latin pool-club party at Naô Pool Club on Wednesday 16 June 2027 from 12:00 to 20:00. The event page describes it as a day party driven by Latin music with poolside tables and general tickets available.
